notes.title: Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection available Now!
notes.content:
Grimorio of Games is thrilled to announce that Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection is now available! This 3D remake of the original ARPG brings fans a completely reimagined experience with modern graphics, dynamic combat, and innovative gameplay mechanics.

Dive into a heartfelt adventure filled with strategy, action, and emotion. With an artistic style inspired by the classics of the 6th console generation, Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection delivers a nostalgic yet modernized journey like no other.
What to Expect in Resurrection

[list]
[*] Turn Foes into Allies: Wield the forbidden power of the Sword of the Necromancer to resurrect your enemies and make them fight by your side.
[*] Dynamic Combat: Engage in fast-paced battles with fluid controls, powerful abilities, and strategic action.
[*] Tactical Summoning: Program the behavior of your summoned creatures with the all-new "Tactics" system.
[*] Endless Replayability: Procedurally generated dungeons ensure every run is unique.
[*] Local Co-op: Team up with a friend and conquer the dungeon together.
[/list]
A Story of Love and Redemption

Join Tama, a former bandit turned bodyguard, as she descends into the depths of a treacherous dungeon to bring her beloved Koko back to life. Navigate dangerous foes and tough decisions in a dark fantasy world filled with mysteries.
Available Now!

Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection is now available for purchase on Steam (PC), Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation, Xbox One and Xbox Series for $19.99/19.99€/16.8£ as a launch offer!
Download Now and Begin Your Adventure!

To celebrate the launch, Grimorio of Games invites players, streamers, and media to share their experiences using #SwordOfTheNecromancer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782880/Sword_of_the_Necromancer_Resurrection/

notes.title: 3D Remake Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection announced
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1243890/view/6215608421519093956][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268040/e638096dfa23e52d63967713f3cd2a6d31fded71.png[/img][/url]

We are pleased to show you the announcement trailer for [i][b]Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection[/b][/i], the [b]3D remake of the original [i]Sword of the Necromancer[/i][/b], which [b]is coming to PC and consoles at the end of summer 2024[/b]. Previously planned as a stretch goal in the sequel's Kickstarter campaign, this remake will now instead be released prior to Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant to give more time to the latter's development.

[previewyoutube=gySxPxnoEv4;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][b]Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection[/b[/i]] will be a [b]reimagining of the original monster-summoning dungeon crawler game[/b], which featured top-down pixel art graphics. Based on Revenant's engine, players will be able to relive Tama's quest to resurrect her lover in 3D, with exciting new ways to battle and renewed mechanics and systems, including the possibility of customizing the summoned monsters' AI. This remake will also feature remastered high quality illustrations and voice acting (both in English and Japanese) and new scenes to delve deeper in Tama and Koko's tragic love story.

You can help us (a lot!) by wishlisting the game!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782880/Sword_of_the_Necromancer_Resurrection/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782880/[/url]

In addition to the new features, beating [i]Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection [/i]will also unlock rewards in [i]Revenant [/i]once it's available, like the possibility of summoning the bosses of the remake (shown at the end of the trailer) as special summons. [i]Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection[/i] will be released on Steam and consoles (Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox One and Xbox Series).

[h2][b]About Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection[/b][/h2]
Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection is a third-person 3D Action Dungeon Crawler where you can revive your defeated enemies to make them fight alongside you. Turn your foes into allies using the forbidden powers of the Sword of the Necromancer and help the rogue Tama reach the dungeon's depths to obtain the power to bring her beloved priestess Koko back from the dead. Assemble a small army of monsters, equip yourself with weapons and relics, and level up to take on the guardians that stand between you and your goal.

[h2]Key features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Turn your foes into allies: Use the Sword of the Necromancer to revive defeated monsters and make them fight alongside you.
[*] Plan your battles, control the dead: Customize your summons' behaviour with the Tactics feature.
[*] New dimension, new battle system: Improved combos and a new companion AI system.
[*] Level up: Enhance your character and your monsters by fighting together.
[*] Relive the journey: Discover Tama and Koko's past as you advance through the dungeon.
[*] Local co-op play: Play with a friend in local co-op.
[/list]

notes.title: Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant Kickstarter campaign to launch in a few weeks
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone![/h1]

We plan to launch a Kickstarter campaign for [i]Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant[/i], just after 2 years of the original game’s launch. The game showcased its first trailer last December, which you can see in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2200940/Sword_of_the_Necromancer_Revenant/]Steam Store page[/url].

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/grimoriog/sword-of-the-necromancer-revenant]Link to the Kickstarter Campaign[/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/grimoriog/sword-of-the-necromancer-revenant][h1]The campaign[/h1][/url]

The first [i]Sword of the Necromancer[/i] also had a successful crowdfunding campaign, raising €201,256 from its initial €15,000 goal. Revenant‘s campaign will have an initial goal to fund the game’s physical edition for consoles, but will include additional stretch goals to add more features to the game in all platforms. [i]Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant[/i] has been announced for PC, Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox One and Xbox Series.

Backers will be able to obtain the game at a lower price than when it comes out. Exclusive campaign rewards will also be available, including a special surprise. The campaign will also offer limited “Early Bird” pledge tiers, so signing up to receive the notification when the campaign launches is recommended! (It also helps us with visibility on Kickstarter!)

In the meantime, players can go to the game’s [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2200940/Sword_of_the_Necromancer_Revenant/]Steam Store page[/url] and wishlist it.

notes.title: Free DLC Extra Modes on June 24th
notes.content:
The free DLC for Sword of the Necromancer is coming to Steam, and consoles on June 24th.

The Extra Modes DLC for Sword of the Necromancer will introduce 3 new game modes to put your skills to test. You will also face 10 new monsters and 8 new bosses! Complete the Extra modes to unlock the Epilogue, a brand new chapter in the story!

With these new game modes, players can jump back into the world of Sword of the Necromancer to face new foes and dominate the dungeons.

[h1][b]Challenge Mode[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268040/9fe40714b8dafd635d34e477e6a49e68169cdc8f.png[/img]

Revisit the base game with a randomized twist. In this new mode you will advance through the five floors of the dungeon as usual, but stay vigilant for new enemies and unexpected encounters!

[h1][b]Colosseum Mode[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268040/0193695d2ea1cb0309c2b9fd6066c144ce10cb42.png[/img]

Test your mettle against hordes of enemies! Starting from level 1 and without any items, defy death as you take on waves of enemies to advance. Chain combos will be key to your survival; the bigger your combo meter, the more XP you will earn and the better the items you will find!

[h1][b]Boss Rush[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268040/884d95bda0790f06e5fd35cc97dd47bd3dc58b6b.png[/img]

Fight against 5 bosses with no breaks! Fight against tougher bosses (both old and new) in quick  succession, with your current adventuring supplies. Level up and gear up to face them! If you complete this mode, you will unlock one of the original bosses as a summon!

[h1][b]Dungeon Builder[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268040/6e6e3386bdfb988b4f9879b2f7bab0d7004072f4.png[/img]

Build and play custom dungeon floors! Create a floor layout, choose the enemies you want to appear and select the boss guarding the exit. You can even choose what items will appear in chests and their properties, so you can set yourself a unique challenge or share a fiendish floor with a friend. Share your creations via a simple text code!

[h1][b]Item Shop[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268040/e41e1c592a176dbb438bf1e17d68833701fd4e4c.png[/img]

When playing the new modes, you will earn Symbols that you can exchange for items in the Item Shop. The item offer will change daily and is the same for all players each day. This feature can help you unlock all of the weapon and relic types, a useful tool for achievement hunters!

[h1][b]Epilogue[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268040/4ae9255d4b9f8afa124cba70b401e6a41df58b6c.png[/img]

Complete the new Extra modes to unlock a new chapter in the story!

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards available!
notes.content:
[h3][b]You can now collect Steam Trading Cards with Sword of the Necromancer![/b][/h3]

Get them all by playing the game or trading with your friends or in the Steam Community Market. Collect all cards to craft a badge you can display on your Steam profile.

You can also get a set of emotes based on the game's monsters and backgrounds for your profile.


[b]How to collect Steam Trading Cards[/b]

Play Sword of the Necromancer and you will get cards based on your playtime. You can get half of the cards through gameplay, but you will need to trade to get the other half!


[b]How to craft a badge[/b]

Once you’ve collected a full set of cards you can make a game badge. When crafting a badge you will receive random rewards, like backgrounds and emotes.

notes.title: Sword of the Necromancer UPDATE 1.1f
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268040/2a1fcb4701a4467af29c88304f796232fcf1b3b3.gif[/img]

[u][b]Update notes:[/b][/u]

- Added a [b]Bag that can store up to 4 items and is accessible at anytime[/b]. Items stored in the bag are not in use and thus do not grant any passive or active effect. Monsters stored in the bag are not healed nor recover their health with time as the monsters you have equipped. [b]The bag will be available after the tutorial level and is enabled by default for all players[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37268040/b705bf57f81fe1b79077d5f9ccdf079edd97c658.gif[/img]

- Added [b]new options in Game Settings[/b]. You can now choose to recall monsters from anywhere, start the game on the floor you last played, and enable/disable the bag. Use the Game Settings to customize your experience.

- Game Settings screen will appear a single time upon boot up after having cleared the tutorial, so no one misses them.

- Fixed several minor bugs and crashes.
